The *Sujātātherīgāthā* (Thig 6.4) is a short poetic text located in the *Therīgāthā* (*Chakkanipāta*, the Book of the Sixes) within the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text preserves the verses attributed to the elder nun (*therī*) Sujātā. SuttaCentral indexes fourteen modern translations across ten languages, including English translations by Bhikkhu Sujato and Ayya Soma [SuttaCentral]. Secondary literature matches for the name "Sujātā" in the reference corpus do not discuss this particular nun's verses; they instead refer to homonymous figures, predominantly the celebrated laywoman who offered milk-rice to the Bodhisatta prior to his awakening, the Bodhisatta in the *Sujāta Jātaka*, or the grieving father named Sujāta in the commentary to Vāsiṭṭhī's verses.

Neither SuttaCentral nor the automated algorithms of DharmaNexus record any external cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
